articles.title: Pablo Neruda on How to Hold Time
articles.highlight: 时间是一条卷走我的河，但我也是河；时间是一团吞噬我的火，但我也是火。
articles.summary: 文章从博尔赫斯关于“时间是河也是火”的句子切入，描述多数人并非博尔赫斯，却在生产力崇拜中把每一分钟变成压在生命脉搏上的刀刃。它值得读，是因为它把时间焦虑放回文学与生命体验中，并提到我们的时间嵌套在我们的时代之中。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键提醒是：时间焦虑往往来自把每一分钟都工具化；读这类文章的价值，是暂时跳出效率视角，重新感受自己也是时间的一部分。
articles.sourceExcerpt: “Time is a river that sweeps me along, but I am a river,” Borges wrote. “Time is a fire that consumes me, but I am the fire.” Most of us are not Borges. Most of us are drowning in bewilderment at where the time goes, burning with the urgency of being alive while waiting to start living, wandering the labyrinth of life with wayward presence, wishing that time ran differently as the cult of productivity turns each minute into a blade pressed against the vein of our transience.

en.highlight: Time is a river that sweeps me along, but I am a river; time is a fire that consumes me, but I am the fire.
en.summary: The piece begins with Borges’s lines on time as both river and fire, then describes most people as not Borges: bewildered by where time goes and pressed by a productivity culture that turns each minute into a blade. articles.summary: 论文聚焦零样本脑电到图像检索，指出与预训练视觉基础模型进行对比式对齐已成为主流范式。摘要提到现有方法通常只将脑电与CLIP族视觉模型对齐，未充分利用层级视觉信息。作者据此提出互补性驱动的双教师层级对齐框架。

articles.sourceExcerpt: 1 Complementarity-Driven Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment for Zero-Shot EEG-to-Image Retrieval Lukun Wu, Jie Li, Ziqi Ren, Ruiyang Xia, Yan Gao, and Xinbo Gao,Fellow, IEEE, Abstract—Decoding visual information from EEG is central to brain–computer interfaces and brain-inspired intelligence, and contrastive alignment with pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) has become the dominant paradigm. However, existing methods align EEG solely with CLIP-family VFMs, leaving hier- archical visual information in neural responses under-exploited. To address this gap, we formulate a mechanism–paradigm correspondence view that links hierarchical visual processing (from appearance to semantics) to the complementary biases of cross-paradigm VFMs, with image-only models (e.g., DINO) and image–text models (e.g., CLIP) capturing distinct facets of this hierarchy.

articles.title: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" exposes passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + HN discussion + Expert analysis
articles.summary: 文章围绕 Claude Code 的“Don't Ask Again”权限捷径，称已有 1,122 个公开 GitHub 文件因此暴露密码。它值得读，是因为把 AI 编码代理的便利性、默认权限与密钥泄露风险放在同一案例中讨论，并伴随 624 分、426 条评论的 HN 讨论热度。
articles.failureAnalysis: “不再询问”这类持久授权设计若缺少细粒度范围、过期机制和密钥访问审计，很容易把一次性便利变成长期泄露面；用户为省事会接受默认放行，安全团队又难在公开仓库扩散前发现。要降低风险，需要默认最小权限、对敏感路径和密钥模式做实时拦截，并承担误报、漏报与合规成本；否则一旦发生公开泄露，产品信任和采用率会先受损。

en.highlight: Claude Code’s “Don’t Ask Again” permission option has been linked to passwords appearing in 1,122 public GitHub files.
en.summary: The item discusses Claude Code’s “Don’t Ask Again” shortcut and reports that 1,122 public GitHub files exposed passwords as a result. It is worth reading because it frames AI coding agents’ convenience, default permissions, and secret-leak risk in one concrete case, with strong Hacker News discussion metrics (624 points, 426 comments).
en.failureAnalysis: Persistent “don’t ask again” permissions can turn convenience into a long-lived exposure surface unless they have narrow scope, expiry, secret-path blocking, and auditability. Without those engineering and compliance controls, users’ default acceptance and weak detection will undermine trust and adoption.
